result.stderr:
Usage: Luthor <rules-file|pattern> [encoding] [--noerror]
  rules-file: text file containing regex rules, one per line, in the format 'name = pattern' or '# comment' at the start of each line
  pattern: a single pattern to match
  encoding: character encoding to use (e.g., UTF-8, UTF-16). default is UTF-8
  noerror: do not generate the error rule
